available.quote: An individual holding a license to practice architecture issued by a proper authority of any jurisdiction, based on credentials that do not conflict with subsection (1) of this section and other provisions of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act, may, upon application, be licensed as an architect

requirements.value: Applicant must pass examination on Nebraska statutes, rules, and other requirements, and demonstrate good reputation and good ethical character by attestation of references. NCARB certificate holders need only pass the state-specific exam and attest to character.
requirements.quote: An individual holding a license to practice architecture issued by a proper authority of any jurisdiction, based on credentials that do not conflict with subsection (1) of this section and other provisions of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act, may, upon application, be licensed as an architect after: (a) Successful passage of an examination on the statutes, rules, and other requirements unique to this state; and (b) Demonstration of good reputation and good ethical character

exists.quote: The Board of Engineers and Architects is created to administer the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act. The board shall consist of eight members appointed by the Governor for terms of five years terminating on the last day of February. The board shall consist of: (a) Three architect members

national_certification.value: National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB)
national_certification.quote: An individual who holds a current and valid certification issued by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards and who submits satisfactory evidence of such certification to the board may, upon application, be licensed as an architect

national_association.quote: Graduation from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accrediting Board

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall not directly or indirectly engage in the practice of architecture or engineering in the state or use the title architect or professional engineer or display or use any words, letters, figures, titles, sign, card, advertisement, or other symbol or device indicating or tending to indicate that he or she is an architect or professional engineer or is practicing architecture or engineering unless he or she is licensed under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act

credential_type.quote: The practice of architecture and engineering and use of the titles architect or professional engineer is a privilege granted by the state through the board based on the qualifications of the individual as evidenced by a certificate of licensure

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to: (a) Practice or offer to practice architecture or engineering in this state without being licensed in accordance with the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act

title_protection.quote: an individual shall not directly or indirectly engage in the practice of architecture or engineering in the state or use the title architect or professional engineer or display or use any words, letters, figures, titles, sign, card, advertisement, or other symbol or device indicating or tending to indicate that he or she is an architect or professional engineer or is practicing architecture or engineering unless he or she is licensed under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to: (a) Practice or offer to practice architecture or engineering in this state without being licensed in accordance with the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act unless such practice or offer to practice is otherwise exempt under the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice architecture without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice or offer to practice architecture or engineering in this state without being licensed in accordance with the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and intentionally employing an unlicensed person to practice architecture
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and intentionally employ or retain a person to practice architecture or engineering in this state who is not licensed in accordance with the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the word 'architect' in a name or business activity without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use the words architect, engineer, or any modification or derivative of such words in its name or form of business activity except as authorized in the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising a title tending to convey the impression of being a licensed architect without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is a licensed architect or professional engineer unless the person is duly licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or attempting to use another person's certificate of licensure or seal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Present or attempt to use the certificate of licensure or the seal of another person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the board in obtaining or attempting to obtain a certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Give any false or forged evidence of any kind to the board or to any member of the board in obtaining or attempting to obtain a certificate
Falsely impersonate any other licensee of like or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to use an expired, suspended, revoked, or nonexistent certificate of licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempt to use an expired, suspended, revoked, or nonexistent certificate of licensure or practice or offer to practice when not qualified

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely claiming to be licensed or authorized under the act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely claim that he or she is licensed or authorized under the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: General violation of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act
Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person in the practice of architecture
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee shall not aid or abet any person not licensed under the act in the practice of architecture or engineering.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affixing seal after certificate expiration or to aid evasion of the act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for a licensee to affix his or her seal or to permit his or her seal to be affixed to any document after the expiration of the certificate or for the purpose of aiding or abetting any other person to evade or attempt to evade the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: An individual licensed under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act may practice or offer to practice the profession of architecture or engineering through an organization if the criteria for organizational practice established by the board are met and the organization has been issued a certificate of authorization by the board.

definition_quote.value: Practice of architecture means providing or offering to provide design services in connection with the construction, enlargement, or alteration of a building or group of buildings and the space within and surrounding the buildings. The services may include, but not be limited to, planning, providing studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions, and administering construction contracts.
definition_quote.quote: Practice of architecture means providing or offering to provide design services in connection with the construction, enlargement, or alteration of a building or group of buildings and the space within and surrounding the buildings. The services may include, but not be limited to, planning, providing studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions, and administering construction contracts.

methods_authorized.quote: The services may include, but not be limited to, planning, providing studies, designs, drawings, specifications, and other technical submissions, and administering construction contracts.

design_build_authorized.quote: Providing combined services involving the practice of architecture or engineering, or both, with construction services is allowed if: (a) An architect participates substantially in, and has direct supervision of, the architectural services provided on the project

value: organization (any form authorized by the board with certificate of authorization)
permitted_firm_structures.quote: An individual licensed under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act may practice or offer to practice the profession of architecture or engineering through an organization if the criteria for organizational practice established by the board are met and the organization has been issued a certificate of authorization by the board.

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.value: At least one licensed architect must be designated as the person in responsible charge of any practice of architecture by the organization
firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: An organization applying for a certificate of authorization shall designate at least one licensed architect as the person in responsible charge of any practice of architecture by the organization

seal_required.quote: Each licensee authorized to practice architecture or engineering must obtain a seal.

exempt_building_types.quote: The provisions of the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act regulating the practice of architecture do not apply to the following activities: (1) The construction, remodeling, alteration, or renovation of a detached single-family through four-family dwelling of less than five thousand square feet of above grade finished space.

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: An individual who holds a current and valid certification issued by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards and who submits satisfactory evidence of such certification to the board may, upon application, be licensed as an architect

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: The board may adopt the examinations and grading procedures of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards. The board may also adopt guidelines published by the council.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Any person who performs any of the actions described in subsection (1) of this section is guilty of a Class I misdemeanor for the first offense

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: a Class IV felony for the second or any subsequent offense

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: Imposition of a civil penalty not to exceed ten thousand dollars for each offense.
